entities.summary: A complex of two contemporary art galleries in kensington gardens and hyde park, in the center of london. these are the serpentine gallery and the serpentine sackler gallery  Originating c. 1970 CE. Serpentine Galleries is a art museum with roots in Europe, arising around 1970. Attributed to Arts Council of Great Britain.
